name: throughput - judge_anchored, qwen, reason_first
_why: One of the three arm-suites used to measure what a second worker does to throughput. Phase 1 runs reps 1-2 with ONE worker, phase 2 raises `reps` to 4 and runs reps 3-4 with TWO. Both phases are the same arms over the same tasks for the same number of reps, so wall time compares directly and not only through a token rate.
_chosen: Chosen because the store holds nothing for it once waivers are honoured. That matters: an arm-suite with partial coverage gives the two phases different amounts of work, because the planner skips what it already has.
_num_ctx_any: as E8: this varies worker count, not the context ceiling.
